title: Bee Protectors Website
snippet: A digital platform designed to raise awareness about bee protection, featuring educational content and conservation initiatives. [cite: 68]
full_text: A digital platform designed to raise awareness about bee protection, featuring educational content and conservation initiatives. This case study details the information architecture redesign, the implementation of a donation flow, and the creation of an interactive map for local volunteer opportunities. Key results include a 30% increase in volunteer sign-ups.

title: Box Hill Art School Study Case
snippet: Box Hill Art School App features intuitive navigation, a streamlined payment process, and more for enhancing user-friendliness. [cite: 69]
full_text: Box Hill Art School App features intuitive navigation, a streamlined payment process, and more for enhancing user-friendliness. The project involved a two-stage redesign focusing on class registration. The solution included user flow mapping, heuristic evaluation of the legacy system, and high-fidelity wireframes for a new course calendar view and subscription model.

title: Cafeteria App Study Case
snippet: A mobile app designed to streamline cafeteria ordering and payment processes for schools and institutions. [cite: 70]
full_text: A mobile app designed to streamline cafeteria ordering and payment processes for schools and institutions. This study highlights the challenges of high-volume ordering at peak times. The design solution involved touchless QR code payment integration, a personalized 'favorite orders' feature, and a clear, single-view cart management system to reduce checkout errors.

title: Cafeteria App - French Version
snippet: Version française de l'application Cafeteria pour commander et payer facilement. [cite: 71]
full_text: Version française de l'application Cafeteria pour commander et payer facilement.
